title: Portal game manifest
description: Schema for apps/web/public/games/<slug>/manifest.json. Authored by scripts/ingest-game-build.mjs. Source of truth for scripts/build-registry.mjs.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case URL slug. No leading/trailing hyphen.

emoji.description: Optional short display marker shown on the portal game card.

hidden.description: When true, the game is valid and playable but hidden from normal portal listing.

repo.description: Source repo URL (https://github.com/<owner>/<name>) or owner/name shorthand.

sourceCommit.description: Git SHA of the source repo at build time.

buildHash.description: sha256 over dist/ contents (see scripts/ingest-game-build.mjs for method).

buildTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this build was ingested.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime, derived from buildTimestamp.

redirectTo.description: Required if status is 'archived' and index.html is not preserved. Absolute URL or /games/<other-slug>/.

assetLicenseSummary.description: Optional one-line summary of asset licenses for games whose source repo carries assets.

assetsDocumented.description: Optional. Asserts the source repo has ASSETS.md.

multiplayer.description: Multiplayer pattern declared by the game. Defaults to 'none' if absent. See docs/multiplayer-architecture.md for the decision tree.

multiplayerProvider.description: Transport identifier when multiplayer is not 'none' or 'local'. Examples: webrtc, partykit, cloudflare-do, netlify-blobs. Required when multiplayer is p2p, realtime-server, or async.

multiplayerEndpoint.description: Optional endpoint URL for the multiplayer transport (e.g. the PartyKit deploy URL). Documentary only; not validated.

expectedAssets.description: Optional asset-presence contract. Each entry names a directory the build MUST contain. Enforced at ingest (against dist/) and in validate-games (against the served dir) — turns a runtime 404 from an empty asset dir into a deploy-time failure.

dir.description: Relative path inside the game (no '..', no leading slash), e.g. 'assets/gen1'.

ext.description: Optional extension filter, e.g. '.png'. Only matching files are counted.

min.description: Minimum number of non-empty matching files required (default 1).

anyOf.description: OR index.html is preserved on disk; checked by validate-games.mjs at filesystem layer.
